$comment: Support tier of every export of the published packages that have no inventory of their own (@atom63/ui-react has ui-react-support-policy.json). check:package-surface copies the tiers into audits/package-surface.json and fails when an export has no tier or a tier names no export. mdx tiers repeat the Stability table in packages/mdx/README.md.

tierDefinitions.stable: The package says it keeps this entry compatible; breaking changes need a major version and migration notes.
tierDefinitions.beta: Importable and supported on the beta dist-tag; the API can still change in a minor version, with a changeset that says how.
tierDefinitions.experimental: Importable, with no compatibility promise; it can change or go away in any release.
